name: What is involved in preparing a bathroom for painting?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in preparing a bathroom for painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom painting preparation involves several steps to ensure a smooth, lasting finish. This includes cleaning the walls thoroughly to remove soap scum and mildew, repairing any cracks or holes, sanding uneven surfaces, and taping off trim and fixtures. We also cover floors and fixtures to protect them from paint splatters. Proper preparation is crucial for a high-quality result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom painting preparation involves cleaning, repairing, sanding, and taping surfaces to ensure a smooth finish.
